{{Quote|I am Ters Sendon, keeper of the histories. A founder, and chronicler, of the Jedi Order. I saw us becoming guardians of knowledge and secrets. We Jedi would safeguard the wisdom of the galaxy.|Ters Sendon's hologram|audio=Sendon-Knowledge-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ters Sendon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was among the founding members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My travels took me across many worlds, more than any other founder. I saw, heard, dreamed.|Ters Sendon's hologram|audio=Sendon-Travels-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Ters Sendon was a [[Je'daii Master]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] who resided on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] after the [[Despot War]]. A Master stationed at [[Kaleth]], Sendon had discovered an ancient [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in the depths of Kaleth's foundations, which he theorized predated the [[Tho Yor Arrival]]. Despite meditating on the holocron on several occasions, Sendon was never able to access it. In the wake of a cataclysmic [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force Storm]] brought on by the arrival of [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] on the planet in [[25,793 BBY]], Sendon found [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Tasha Ryo]] attempting to identify an alien skull found aboard Xesh's ship. Drawn to her because of her frustration, the pair delved into the underlevels of Kaleth to consult the Kwa [[Holocron of A'nang|holocron]]. Sendon watched as Ryo successfully activated the device and awakened its [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] [[A'nang]] of the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]].<ref name="DOTJ7" /> Recounting the Kwa's history on Tython, A'nang's holocron analyzed the skull as Sendon requested but turned off after realizing it was that of a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 3]]</ref> Realizing its importance, Sendon and Ryo took the skull and the holocron to [[Akar Kesh]] to seek further guidance. In the chambers of [[Je'daii Temple Master]] [[Ketu]], Sendon and Ryo turned over the holocron to Master [[Rajivari]], a respected Je'daii and a holocron scholar. Asking the holocron for guidance, A'nang identified the skull as Rakatan and warned of the Je'daii that their world was in terrible peril if the Rakata were seeking them out. Realizing their danger, Master Ketu began planning to mobilize the Order's defenses in preparation of war.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:TersSendonHologram-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|Ters Sendon recorded a teaching hologram.]]
When the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] launched its [[invasion of the Tython system]], Sendon was never far from Tasha Ryo, who served the Order as one of its foremost [[seer]]s. Stationed at [[Ryo Fortress]] on [[Shikaakwa]], Sendon was with Ryo when she suffered from a form of psychic backlash; an attack perpetrated by the Empire. Blinded, both to the Force and natural vision, Ryo collapsed into Sendon's arms screaming that Xesh was behind the attack and that war would come to the [[Chasm]] and the areas around [[Anil Kesh]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 3">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 3]]</ref> Escorting Ryo back to Tython despite her blindness to the Force, the pair remained at Anil Kesh to meditate on the holocron in hopes that it might offer guidance in the coming battle. Deep in meditation, the holocron began to crackle between the pair, becoming too much for Sendon to handle. Recoiling, the holocron's power exerted itself on Ryo and began to awaken Tython so that it might defend itself from the Rakata.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 4]]</ref> Taking Ryo and the holocron to Anil Kesh's lowest level, as the battle raged around the facility, Sendon listened as A'nang detailed the requirements to activate the [[Tho Yor]] and weaponize them against the Rakata. Realizing that Ryo would not survive the process, he hoped to find another way but Ryo quieted his fears. Telling Ryo that he would miss her, Sendon allowed the young Je'daii Ranger to leap out into the void and activate the Tho Yor. Realizing that the Temple was in danger when Ryo's body dissolved in the pure Force energy emanating from the holocron, Sendon fled while ordering an evacuation of the facility.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref>

Some times after the defeat of the Rakata, the [[Force Wars]] ravaged Tython in different ways. Along with Masters [[Garon Jard]], [[Rajivari]], and [[Cala Brin]], Sendon was one of the original founders of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The chronicler of the Order, Sendon instilled within the Order his thoughtfulness towards the collection of knowledge and wished for the Order to be the guardians of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] wisdom. He was the most traveled of the founder, echoing his belief that to dispel ignorance and share understanding with others, a Jedi has to learn from others cultures. He recorded his testimony and that of his compatriots on devices that would eventually be forgotten on Tython as the Jedi abandoned the world at the conclusion of the war.<ref name="TOR" />

===Legacy===
[[File:Ters_Sendon.png|thumb|right|200px|Ters Sendon hologram]]
{{Quote|Activation protocol begins. A new Jedi comes to learn? Excellent, excellent.|Ters Sendon's hologram|audio=Sendon-Intro-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Many millennia later, following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a hologram of Master Sendon was discovered on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] when the Order relocated from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As well as recordings of Masters Brin and Jard, a [[Teaching hologram|hologram]] of Master Sendon was retrieved from the [[Tythonian Gnarls]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Those who stand tall in history are supported by a thousand nameless faces. Jedi seek to dispel ignorance. To understand other cultures, and bring that understanding to others. Never forget that, wherever your path leads.|Ters Sendon's hologram|audio=Sendon-Ignorance-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Ters Sendon saw the Jedi as guardians of knowledge and secrets, dispeling ignorance and sharing understanding of other cultures.<ref name="TOR" />
